record.title: Microduck head-yaw output cage — 'yaw_roll_motion' in Pollen's MJCF: 34 x 35.9 x 22.5 mm cage that hangs the head-yaw XL330 under its top plate and offers the head-roll joint (Ø16 bearing boss one side, XL330 horn pattern the other)
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid (bin/cad part:microduck-yaw-roll-motion, 2026-09-02) and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen's own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-simulator/meshes/yaw_roll_motion.stl: p95 surface distance 0.38 mm ref->ours / 0.90 mm ours->ref, bbox delta [0.0, -0.01, 0.034] mm, 6/6 reference holes and bosses matched, 0 unmatched (out/refcheck/microduck-yaw-roll-motion/r1, evidence/refcheck/2026-09-01T19-39-39Z). The 13 'extra in ours' features are real vendor features the 1242-tri sim mesh cannot resolve; the denser rl-set re-export confirms every one at the same coordinates (see docs/README.md).
record.origin_why: modelled by hand in cecad from measurements taken off Pollen Robotics' decimated visual meshes (CC BY-SA-NC sim assets) with cecad.meshslice cut-plane probes (out/measure/neckgrp/yr_slices_*.png) and cecad.meshfeatures; nobody has Pollen's CAD and no physical part has been measured. Admitted through the TRIAD.md door: evidence/ledger.jsonl + computed trust.json.
record.source_reference: reference/pollen-microduck-simulator/meshes/yaw_roll_motion.stl (Pollen microduck simulator meshes; measurements also taken off the denser reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/yaw_roll_motion.stl, same bbox)
record.why_this_folder_exists: The link between the Microduck's head-yaw and head-roll joints: the head-yaw XL330 hangs under its top plate (30 x 16 Ø2.5 case pattern) with its horn on neck_pitch below, and the head rolls about the mesh-y axis through its Ø18/Ø16 cheek discs — horn pattern toward the roll servo in the head, Ø16 x 4 bearing boss with Ø12 bore on the other side. Nothing on the shelf cages an XL330 and offers a perpendicular roll axis 11.5 mm below its mount plate.
